page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The processor includes 48 MB of L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration via AES and SHA extensions.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7.8xlarge demonstrates consistent mid-range performance across multiple workloads. The single-core stress-ng CPU score is 1865.39, while the multi-core score reaches 30983.52. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1689.81 GB/sec and a large block uncached write bandwidth of 65.94 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance achieves 30.13 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database score of 13455.54. Large language model inference using a small 135M model yields a strong text generation speed of 282.15 tokens per second, though performance scales down to 17.54 tokens per second for a medium 7B model.

The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration. The high memory density relative to the dedicated CPU cores makes it suitable for hosting in-memory databases like Redis, enterprise applications, caching layers, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
